The domain of $\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+1)$ is $(-\infty ,\infty ).$  

As $x$ increases to $\infty ,$ the graph tends to $y=\frac{\pi }{2}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \,\infty }\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+1)) & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{1}{2}\cdot (\frac{\pi }{2})) \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
